headline: Wirtualna Polska Holding presented its financial results
summary: Wirtualna Polska Holding's third-quarter net profit attributable to shareholders was PLN 92.7 million, down from PLN 97.7 million a year earlier. Group revenue rose 2.4% to PLN 739.6 million.
why: Wirtualna Polska is a major Polish digital media and online services group, and its results reflect advertising and e-commerce trends.
original_headline: Wirtualna Polska Holding pokazała wyniki finansowe
